blocks.x:
Born in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.
Veteran of the 1st World War.
University of Pennslyvania Graduate - Bachelor and Master's
degree in Education, Class of 1944.
Orchestra Leader - Composer - Arranger and Music Teacher.

One year at the Original Club Alabam, Broadway and 44th Street,
New York City.
The first Jazz Touring Orchestra in Europe.
The first to Record Jazz Overseas, Berlin, Germany, 1925.
The first to tour in Russia, 1926.
The first to tour in South America, Buenos Aires, 1927.
The first Black Orchestra to give Jazz Concert anywhere,
Copenhagen, Denmark, 1931.
